warfarer.summary: Warfarer is the Arisen-only vocation whose single native weapon skill, Rearmament, swaps between up to 9 carried weapons; it can use any unlocked weapon skill of a vocation, but only while holding that vocation's weapon. TU3.2 (Sept 1-2, 2026) raised the weapon-skill cap from 4 to 6, so with Rearmament in slot 1 each weapon gets 5 real skills, and mod #1532 auto-loads a separate 6-skill set per weapon vocation on every swap. Warfarer has lower base stats (no vocation multipliers, only +20 Knockdown Power). Whether it gets other vocations' core skills and Maister skills is disputed between sources and must be tested in game.

rules.text: Warfarer's only native (Maister) weapon skill: instantly switches to the next weapon on your person, in the order set in the Equipment menu. It occupies a weapon-skill slot and costs a small ('minimal') amount of stamina; no numeric value published. Mod #1532 can remove the stamina cost and has an 'Apply rearm to all' shortcut that writes id 100 to slot 1 of every set. Unlocked via The Sotted Sage (3 Newt Liqueur to Lamond) then Grandmaster's Path.

A Game8 commenter notes you can drop Rearmament and swap weapons manually in the Equipment menu to gain a sixth real skill; the mod's per-weapon auto-swap still triggers on weapon change (inference: its hook is on changeWeapon, not on the skill itself).
TU3.2 expanded assignable weapon skills from four to six in the base game. Launch-era guides that say 'three slots left after Rearmament' are superseded.
Warfarer can equip any weapon and armor and uses a vocation's weapon skills only while that vocation's weapon is in hand, and only skills already unlocked on that vocation.

CONFLICT. Fextralife (Warfarer and Core Skills pages) and TheGamer say Warfarer uses the core skills of the held weapon that you unlocked (e.g. Levitate and Anodyne with a staff, Galvanize with an archistaff); Game8 says Warfarer's 'currently equipped core skill depends on the weapon equipped'. The #1585 author says Warfarer gets other skills 'without the core class traits' (e.g. Thief Footpad), and a user report on True Warfarer mentions 'core skills missing'. The likely reconciliation is that the basic moveset (light/heavy/vocation action) follows the weapon while some purchasable traits may not, but this is untested.

CONFLICT. Fextralife and TheGamer (2024) say Warfarer cannot use other vocations' Maister skills, yet mod #1532 lists Riotous Fury, Heavenly Shot, Celestial Paean, Blades of the Pyre, Formless Feint, Arc of Might, Meteoron, Maelstrom, Wild Furie, Martyr's Bolt and Dragon's Delusion as selectable. Whether they actually fire when forced into a Warfarer slot is untested; every build that uses one lists an alternate.

Warfarer has lower base stats than other vocations: no stat multipliers and only a +20 Knockdown Power adjustment (Mage is x1.4 Magick, Sorcerer x1.6). Damage builds should lean on Verve/Sagacity and high-stat weapons.
CONFLICT. Game8 and Fextralife say only the heaviest carried weapon counts toward weight; Pixel Twelve says every carried weapon adds weight.

Up to 6 augments equipped at once, changeable only at a Vocation Guild; any learned augment can be equipped on any vocation. Warfarer's own augments are Zeal (weapon-skill stamina -5%) and Dynamism (less weight slowdown). One source says equipped sets are saved per vocation; either way a single Warfarer set must serve every weapon you carry.

High Flagration, High Levin and High Frigor (ids 24-26) belong to both staff and archistaff, so Rearmament between staff and archistaff keeps them available; swapping elemental staves can stand in for Affinity buffs.

UI only: unequip weapons, change weapon order, swap/compare from the equipped-weapons list; shield stats show when only a shield is equipped. A bug where an enchantment persisted after re-enchanting plus Rearmament was fixed.

PS layout: L1 + face button fires weapon skills 1-4, R1 = Vocation Action. PC defaults (partial): LMB light, RMB vocation action, Ctrl switch skills, Space jump, V heavy (low confidence). TU3.2 added keyboard control types that fire or switch weapon skills with a single button. How slots 5-6 are bound on pad is not documented.
No source documents a Warfarer-specific incantation penalty. General rules apply: Quickspell (if active), Ring of Recitation/Articulacy, standing still.
TheGamer reports that as soon as a Warfarer swaps weapons the Trickster simulacrum begins disappearing, so censer kits that rely on the decoy should be run as a 'stay on censer' set.

#1532, #1142 (Enhanced Warfarer, replaces mismatched skills with Rearmament) and #1585 (TWINWV, swaps the real vocation so core traits work) all rewrite slots on weapon change; running more than one is likely to conflict.

Id 101 (Job04_FakeMaster) is Blades of the Pyre. Ids 102-120 (two per vocation, three for Trickster) are unnamed and most likely Dark Arisen (Oct 9, 2026) skills shipped dormant; the mod excludes them.

open_questions.question: Does Warfarer get the held weapon's core skills (True Deflect, Repulse, Levitate, Quickspell, Footpad, Quik Fot, Effigial Incense, etc.)?
open_questions.how_to_test: As Warfarer with the relevant skills unlocked on their vocation: (1) sword+shield, press guard (RMB/RB) the instant a goblin swing lands and look for the parry spark and stagger (True Deflect); (2) staff, jump then press Jump again and see if you float (Levitate); (3) daggers, jump at a wall then Jump again (Footpad); (4) duospear, hold RB 2 s, release, press Jump within 0.5 s of the hit (Quik Fot); (5) censer, press Vocation Action and see if a simulacrum appears.

open_questions.question: Do Maister skills forced in by mod #1532 actually fire on Warfarer?
open_questions.how_to_test: Slot Riotous Fury (12), Arc of Might (61), Meteoron (68), Wild Furie (79), Martyr's Bolt (91) etc. into a set, rearm to that weapon, press the skill on a training target (e.g. a goblin camp). Note whether the animation plays, stamina/HP is consumed and damage lands, versus nothing happening or a greyed icon.

open_questions.question: Does the TU3.2 Magick Barrier core skill work when a Warfarer holds a staff or archistaff?
open_questions.how_to_test: As Warfarer holding a staff, press Vocation Action while not incanting next to an attacking enemy; check for a barrier and whether hits are blocked and stamina drains.

open_questions.question: Does the TU3.2 Formless Feint Vocation-Action timing (off-balance + stamina-drain pause) work under Warfarer?
open_questions.how_to_test: As Warfarer with daggers, activate Formless Feint (42) and press Vocation Action just as an enemy hit connects; watch whether the attacker staggers and the stamina drain pauses.

open_questions.question: Does an Affinity / Ignited Blades enchant survive Rearmament to another weapon?
open_questions.how_to_test: Cast Fire Affinity (29) on yourself with the staff, Rearmament to a sword, and hit an enemy; check for fire damage numbers/burn and whether the enchant icon remains.

open_questions.question: Is the Trickster simulacrum available on Warfarer at all, and how fast does it fade after a swap?
open_questions.how_to_test: Hold a censer as Warfarer, press Vocation Action to summon, then Rearmament once and count seconds until the decoy vanishes; also try Suffocating Shroud (95) to see whether aggro goes to the decoy or to you.

open_questions.question: How are slots 5 and 6 bound on controller and keyboard when combined with the mod's hold-key second set?
open_questions.how_to_test: Open Options > Controls/Button Mapping after installing #1532, fill all 6 slots and the swap set, then press each slot input and the mod hotkey in a safe area; note any overlap or ignored input.

open_questions.question: Do Vimtaking-nerf and Prescient Flare TU3.2 changes also apply to the upgraded Lifetaking Arrow and Augural Flare?
open_questions.how_to_test: Fire Lifetaking Arrow (86) through a pack once locked on a pawn and once not, comparing heal amount and range; for Augural Flare (67), note detonation timing and whether a second Flare amplifies the first.

warfarer.menu_lag: The Vocation Guild slowdown comes from the paused menu rendering a second camera and a 3D character mockup, which is heavy at high settings or low VRAM (per the Dynamic Menu Overhaul #1641 description). Menu Performance Bug Fix #1608 (ArrythmiaFPS, v1.3, Sep 23, 2026, needs REFramework) disables character-model rendering in menus and 'completely eliminates' the loss 'including the Vocation Guild'; v1.2 fixed Guild interaction and v1.3 fixed the mockup reappearing after the Buy menu. Use #1608 OR #1641 (which already includes the fix), not both. A 'Menu Performance Fix.lua' hooking app.ui040101_00:update() (the Guild screen) is already in the user's REFramework autorun, so check that before adding another. No mod was found that disables the skill-preview videos themselves; if lag persists specifically while a preview video plays, #1608 may not fully cover it (inference).

vocations.name: Fighter
vocations.summary: Shield tank whose damage comes from parry stuns, Shield Pummel knockdowns and heavy-attack follow-ups; TU3.2 made Burst Strike, Tusk Toss, Counter Slash and Riotous Fury more reliable.

core_skills.name: Defend / Deflect
core_skills.input: Hold Vocation Action (RB / R1) / Right Click
core_skills.when: Default guard; stamina regenerates slowly while guarding, each blocked hit costs stamina. Cannot block grabs or hits from behind. TU3.2 changed Deflect behaviour against ranged attacks.

core_skills.name: True Deflect
core_skills.input: Press RB / R1 / Right Click the instant before an attack lands
core_skills.when: Main damage and stagger engine against melee bosses and humanoids; negates damage, staggers, and counters cost no stamina while it is active.

core_skills.name: Tusk Toss
core_skills.input: Hold light attack (LMB / X / Square) to charge, release
core_skills.when: Launch goblins and wolves; follow-up after Onslaught flinches a target. TU3.2 made it less likely to fail and easier to chain into.

core_skills.name: Steeled Foundation
core_skills.when: When thrown off an ogre or griffin, or to take cliff shortcuts that would otherwise be lethal.

core_skills.name: Enchanted Counter
core_skills.input: Guard while your weapon is enchanted (passive)
core_skills.when: With a Mage Affinity or elemental sword, every block hits the attacker with the element and builds burn/frost.

core_skills.name: Onslaught / Empale
core_skills.when: Heavy becomes a powerful successive strike on downed, off-balance or unaware targets; use after every Shield Pummel knockdown.
